newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot to fight EOCC entry in bias case.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot to fight EOCC entry in bias case.

text.p: Home Depot Inc on Monday said it would oppose the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission's intervention in a sex discrimination case.

The federal agency is intervening in a 1995 case, filed in U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana, that claims that women were hired for jobs as cashiers but not considered for promotions.
Home Depot said the agency only heard one side before deciding to intervene.

"The Home Depot will vigorously oppose intervention and is confident that it can demonstrate that intervention is not only futile but a waste of government resources," Larry Smith, Home Depot's vice president-legal, said in a statement.
Home Depot, a do-it-yourself building supply retailer, said it was proud of its record of hiring and promoting women to every level in the company.
